'''May 2000 Milwaukee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Egomania, Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 6 May 2000. [[Steve Kuperman]] won it. It is known from Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d675">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-milwaukee-wisconsion-5-6-2000d675/ milwaukee-wisconsion-5-6-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 6 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-milwaukee-wisconsion-5-6-2000d675/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Egomania, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]
